2. Scope and Roles: Controller and Processor
NXAI acts in different capacities depending on the context.
When we collect personal data directly from you — for example, when you register for an account, visit our websites, or contact our support team — we act as the data controller.

When you, as a business customer, use our Services to communicate with your own end users (for example, sending SMS, voice, or WhatsApp messages through the NXLINK or NXCLOUD platform), we act as a data processor on your behalf, and you remain the data controller for your end users' personal data. Requests from your end users regarding their personal data should be directed to you as the controller; we will support you in responding to such requests in accordance with our Data Processing Agreement (DPA).
We collect the following categories of personal data:
Account and registration data: name, business email address, company name, country/region, account password.
Communication data processed on behalf of our business customers.
Usage and technical data: log data, IP address, device and browser information, collected automatically when you use our websites or Services.
Support data: information you provide when you contact our customer support team.
4. How and Why We Use Your Information
We process personal data for the following purposes, on the legal bases indicated below:

Our websites use cookies and similar technologies for essential, functional, and analytics purposes. You can manage your preferences at any time using the Cookie Preferences tool available on our websites. For further detail, please see our Cookie Policy at

We do not sell your personal data. We may share personal data with cloud infrastructure service providers who host and process data on our behalf; professional advisors, auditors, and regulators, where required by law; and law enforcement or government authorities, where required by applicable law.

NXAI operates service sites (each, a "Service Site") through a number of third-party cloud infrastructure providers across multiple countries and regions, currently including Hong Kong, Singapore, Indonesia, Chile, and the European Union, and may add or adjust such Service Sites from time to time as our business evolves. Personal data relating to a particular service is generally stored and processed within the Service Site corresponding to that service, in order to meet applicable data localization requirements in the relevant jurisdiction.

To provide the Services and support our global operations, personal data may be transferred across countries or regions within the NXAI group, including from the Service Site where it is stored to other NXAI group companies or personnel, for operational support and customer service. Such intra-group transfers are governed by NXAI's intra-group data transfer agreement. For the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and other jurisdictions with specific legal requirements for cross-border transfers, NXAI will adopt appropriate transfer safeguards required by applicable law, including regulator-approved mechanisms such as standard contractual clauses.

We retain personal data for as long as necessary to provide the Services and to comply with our legal obligations. Our standard retention period is 2 years. Certain categories of data, such as system and security logs, may be subject to different retention periods as set out in our internal data retention schedule.

We maintain technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal data, including encryption in transit, access controls, and multi-factor authentication for systems handling customer data. NXAI holds ISO/IEC 27001 (Information Security Management), ISO/IEC 27701 (Privacy Information Management), and ISO 9001 (Quality Management) certifications, each subject to periodic independent audit and recertification.
